srsRequirements: IM-001 to IM-009: Inventory management (track equipment attributes, status, location, barcode, prevent rental of maintenance items)
CM-001 to CM-007: Customer management (B2B-only validation, contact history, credit limits, self-registration with approval)
RM-001 to RM-012: Rental management (requests, quotations, contracts, delivery/pickup scheduling, extensions, security deposits, condition checklists)
BI-001 to BI-011: Billing and invoicing (invoice generation, tax calculation, payment methods, late fees, security deposits, receipts, aging reports)
MM-001 to MM-007: Maintenance management (preventive schedules, repair workflows, warranty claims, availability after maintenance)
RA-001 to RA-008: Reporting and analytics (utilization, revenue, customer lifetime value, real-time inventory dashboard, export formats)
CP-001 to CP-008: Customer portal (authenticated browsing, rental requests, view active/past rentals, invoice/payment access, online payments, extensions, notifications, document upload)
WI-001 to WI-006: Website integration (real-time inventory API, product catalog API, rental inquiry submission, secure authentication via tokens/API keys, branding synchronization)
NFR Performance: PF-001 (page load <3s), PF-002 (50+ staff, 100+ portal concurrent users), PF-003 (inventory search <2s), PF-004 (reports <10s for 10k records)

NFR Security: SR-001 (HTTPS/TLS 1.2+), SR-002 (bcrypt password hashing), SR-003 (RBAC), SR-004 (audit logs for sensitive data), SR-005 (30-min session timeout), SR-006 (input validation against SQLi/XSS), SR-007 (encryption at rest for PII/financial), SR-008 (automated backups with point-in-time recovery)

NFR Privacy: PP-001 (data protection law compliance), PP-002 (no third-party sharing without consent), PP-003 (customer data access), PP-004 (data deletion on request), PP-005 (audit logs for personal data access)

NFR Operational: OR-001 (99.5% monthly uptime), OR-002 (maintenance 2AM-5AM IST with notice), OR-003 (user-friendly error messages), OR-004 (multilingual support base English, Hindi capable), OR-005 (deployable on cloud or on-premise)

NFR Maintainability: MS-001 (modular architecture), MS-002 (documented code, standards), MS-003 (automated testing), MS-004 (admin DB maintenance tools), MS-005 (installation/configuration/admin/troubleshooting docs)

NFR Portability: PT-001 (Chrome 80+, Firefox 75+, Safari 13+, Edge 80+), PT-002 (responsive design for tablet/desktop), PT-003 (deployable on LAMP/WAMP/LAPP), PT-004 (DB schema portable between MySQL and PostgreSQL)

Business Rules: BR-001 (B2B only, no individual consumers), BR-002 (minimum rental periods: 1 day laptops/computers, 1 week servers/network), BR-003 (20% security deposit for equipment >₹50,000), BR-004 (late fees: ₹500/day laptops/computers, ₹2000/day servers), BR-005 (mandatory maintenance every 6 months or 500 usage hours)

Compliance: CL-001 (audit trails for financial transactions), CL-002 (rental agreements per Indian Contract Act), CL-003 (GST-compliant invoices with HSN/SAC), CL-004 (records retained ≥8 years per Indian tax law), CL-005 (TDS certificate generation as applicable)
improvementAreas: Implement backend REST API to serve inventory, pricing, and rental requests per WI-001 to WI-006
Develop customer portal with authentication, rental request flow, and payment processing (CP-001 to CP-008)
Build admin dashboard for inventory, customer, billing, and reporting management (IM-001 to RA-008)
Enhance accessibility: add descriptive alt text to all images, aria-label/aria-controls to slider controls, skip navigation link, ensure focus outlines meet WCAG AA
Optimize performance: lazy-load images, minify and compress CSS/JS, leverage browser caching, use modern image formats (WebP), reduce render-blocking resources
Refactor CSS: eliminate duplicate rules, adopt CSS custom properties for colors/theme, add media queries for breakpoint-specific layout adjustments
Add missing metadata: description, keywords, author, and fix placeholder URLs (e.g., tel:+, info@.com)
Implement form validation and server-side processing for quote, contact, and rental inquiry forms

Ensure compliance with SRS non-functional requirements: security (HTTPS, password hashing, RBAC), privacy (data protection, audit logs), operational (uptime, maintenance windows), and business rules (B2B-only, deposits, late fees)

currentState.accessibility: Missing alt text for banner images, missing ARIA labels for slider controls, missing skip-to-content link, placeholder links with href='#', missing meta description, insufficient focus styles.
cssIssues: .container and .section-heading defined twice, leading to potential override issues
Unused selectors like .hero-content and .hero-text increase CSS size
Lack of CSS custom properties (variables) for theming
No explicit media queries; relies solely on fluid layouts which may not cover all breakpoints
Heavy use of backdrop-filter and blur effects can impact rendering performance on low-end devices
currentState.htmlStructure: Generally semantic (header, nav, section, footer) but lacks <main> and <article> wrappers for primary content; slider navigation buttons lack aria-label attributes; dot indicators are <span> instead of <button>; several images (e.g., banner images) have missing or generic alt attributes; footer contact details contain placeholders.
currentState.jsFunctionality: JavaScript limited to slider autoplay and scroll-triggered animations; no dynamic data fetching from backend APIs; no user authentication or session handling; no form validation or submission handling for quote/contact forms; no integration with rental management system as per SRS.
currentState.performance: No lazy loading of offscreen images; images served at full resolution; no minification or compression of CSS/JS files; render-blocking external resources (Google Fonts, Font Awesome) without font-display swap; no caching headers or service worker for offline capability.
currentState.responsiveness: Uses flexible grid and layout (flexbox, auto-fit grid) that adapt to viewport width, but lacks explicit media query breakpoints for fine-tuning at specific device widths; no viewport-specific typography adjustments; touch target sizes may be insufficient on small screens.
